checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Arms extend parallel to floor, palms facing inward.
checks.feet: Straight legs lower from 45 to 15 degrees while torso reclines; pelvis stays supported.
checks.movement: Controlled high-to-low boat transition, straight legs, arms horizontal, balanced pelvic support; return to high boat.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Eight-second controlled transition is illustrative, not a prescribed training tempo.
